## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 514 captures during October 2024. This activity provides the basis for the month’s image-quality and grading review. Captures were processed for assessment, with results reviewed to identify images requiring further consideration and cases meeting the referable threshold.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. A total of 7 captures were ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 1.4. These images could not be used for a grading outcome and should remain visible in routine quality monitoring. The ungradable results provide a focus for ongoing review of capture technique and image acceptability.

## Grading

Grading identified 137 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This measure supports monitoring of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process. Together, the referable results and median lag provide a summary of the clinical workload and timeliness of review for North City Eye Clinic during October 2024.
